name: Pigmentation and sun damage
summary: Years of sun exposure surface gradually, often appearing long after the exposure itself, and typically across the face, chest and the back of hands.
statement: Years of sun exposure *surface gradually, often appearing long after the exposure itself*, and typically across the face, chest and the back of hands.
happening: Pigment irregularities usually reflect years of cumulative sun exposure rather than a single event, surfacing gradually as melanin production becomes uneven across the skin. Hormonal factors and inflammation can also influence where and how pigment appears. Because the causes vary, the right approach depends on the pattern and depth of the pigmentation itself.

factors.title: Cumulative exposure
factors.text: Pigmentation and sun damage usually reflect cumulative exposure and skin behaviour over years, not a single recent cause.

factors.title: Barrier and turnover
factors.text: Changes to the skin barrier and cell turnover rate influence how visible pigmentation and sun damage become over time.

factors.title: Individual variation
factors.text: How pigmentation and sun damage present and respond to treatment varies meaningfully between skin types.

recommendedText: Considered as a precise option for pigmentation, targeting concentrated areas of discolouration with minimal disruption to surrounding skin.
alongsideText: Often assessed alongside, since these concerns frequently share the same treatment options.

steps.title: Assessment first
steps.text: We confirm the type of pigmentation before recommending anything, since sun damage and melasma respond differently.

steps.title: Depth and pattern
steps.text: Where the pigment sits in the skin and how widely it is spread shape which treatment is considered.

steps.title: Protection alongside
steps.text: Daily sun protection is part of the plan, since new exposure can undo progress.

steps.title: Ongoing review
steps.text: Pigment can return with sun exposure, so the plan is reviewed at follow-up and adjusted as needed.
